content.short: Elliptic provides blockchain analytics for crypto compliance, investigations, and financial crime risk management.
content.description: Elliptic is a blockchain analytics and crypto compliance company. Its site describes risk management, investigations, stablecoin risk tools, network integrations, and compliance workflows for businesses, regulators, exchanges, and financial institutions. The TON relevance is compliance coverage and investigative tooling, not a consumer wallet experience. Blockchain analytics for financial crime risk management and regulatory compliance in crypto. Users see this through financial institutions & fintechs, stablecoin & token issuers, centralized exchanges, and decentralized finance.
